podcast.title: Joining Craguer (1975)
podcast.body: Carl Bartons, already known as a very good musician, joined Craguer in 1975 around the time of the *Autobahn* album. His work on *Autobahn* was described as an "authentic success." "No estuvo al principio, pero sonido al grupo en la Agida del Autobahn en 1975."

podcast.title: Departure from Craguer (1990)
podcast.body: After many years together, Carl Bartons left Craguer in the 1990s, specifically in 1990. His departure was "a bit invited to leave" by Ralph and Florian, occurring during a period when Craguer was not in its best shape in the late 1980s and early 1990s. "finalmente en los 90, en 1990, abandonó el grupo un poco invitado a marcharse por Ralph y Florian."

podcast.title: Distinct Musical Contributions to Craguer
podcast.body: Carl Bartons brought significantly different ideas to Craguer compared to Ralph and Florian, making a substantial contribution. He was a less melodic and less symphonic individual, much more interested in "canned sounds," synthesizers, and especially "looped canned sounds," which later became characteristic of Craguer's sound, particularly in albums like *Computer World*. "Él leó una persona mucho menos melodica, mucho menos sinfónica que le interesaba mucho más los sonidos enlatados, los sintetizadores, y sobre todo los sonidos loops enlatados que fueron después de sacar aterísticos de Craguerda y el mando así o el en Computer World."

podcast.title: Extensive Post-Craguer Career
podcast.body: Following his departure from Craguer, Carl Bartons embarked on countless projects. He formed two solo groups, collaborated with a multitude of artists, and has been a prolific producer for many people. His work over the last 20 years is described as virtually infinite. "Tras un marcha, Carl Bartons hizo infinidad de proyectos. Tuvo dos grupos en solitario, trabajó con un montón de artistas, ha sido productorlo muchísimo asente, y los trabajos que ha hecho en los últimos 20 años son prácticamente incinitos."

podcast.title: Misconception as Founding Member of Craguer
podcast.body: There is a common, erroneous belief among the few people who know Carl Bartons that he was a founding member of the group Craguerda de Mánia. This is incorrect. "los pocos que lo conocen creen erroneamente que ha sido un niembro fundador del grupo Craguerda de Mánia. Pero eso no es cierto de así."

podcast.title: Pillar of Modern Music
podcast.body: Carl Bartons is described as a very important, unsung artist who has been a pillar of modern music, yet many people are unfamiliar with him or his history. "ha sido un pilar de la música moderna y que hay que conocer."

podcast.title: Prolific Demos in the Mid-70s
podcast.body: In the mid-1970s, Carl Bartons was exceptionally prolific, constantly creating demos and small musical compilations. "Carl Bartons, al mitad de los 70, estaba en una ofregrativa tan importante que no para hacer relaciones y pequeñas recopilaciones."
